title: More ways to
intro: Face a shared world boss, turn Ancient items into farming expeditions, or build your strength one survival wave at a time. These adventures are free for every account.
footer: Bring your build, find your next challenge, and play by the same rules as everyone else.
updated: Rules checked on October 31, 2026. Alpha balance may change; in-game announcements take priority.

boss.name: Global Boss
boss.summary: The Crusader King awaits in Fields of Misery. His health is shared across Global Boss sessions: every participant contributes to the same battle.
steps: In the lobby, open Game Settings and choose Global Boss. Enter this mode; the encounter does not spawn in your ordinary Adventure or Campaign session.
Watch the global announcements for the spawn and map. Travel to Fields of Misery and follow the purple boss marker on the minimap.
Join the fight alone or with a party. Sessions hold up to 8 players, with optional parties of up to 5; other sessions contribute to the same health pool.
facts: Scheduled every day on the hour, 00:00–23:00, America/Sao_Paulo (UTC−3).
600 trillion base health. Each additional counted participant adds 100% of base health; leaving does not reduce it.
If the boss survives until the next scheduled hour, his health is restored. Coordinate your damage before the next reset.
boss.reward: This encounter currently offers the shared combat challenge. Automatic item and currency rewards are not yet available.
boss.note: Expect teleportation, melee attacks, whirlwind and summoned enemies. The encounter uses level-70 monsters and Torment XVI difficulty.

cow.name: Ancient Cow Level
cow.kicker: AN ANCIENT OFFERING. A BOVINE EXPEDITION.
cow.summary: Use an Ancient Bovine Bardiche to open Not The Cow Level with RuinWatch’s Ancient equipment rule. The quality of the item you sacrifice determines the special loot rule.
steps: Obtain a Bovine Bardiche while farming equipment. Check its tooltip: it must be Ancient or Primal to activate this variant.
In an Adventure Mode town, open Kanai’s Cube. Place only the Bardiche inside and transmute it. The weapon is consumed; no extra crafting materials are required.
Enter the portal to Not The Cow Level. Party members in the same game can follow you through the portal and farm the map.
facts: Ancient and Primal Bardiches both activate the Ancient rule.
Eligible legendary and set equipment drops are forced to Ancient quality, not guaranteed Primal.
A regular Bardiche opens the standard version without this guarantee.
cow.reward: Farm equipment, materials, gems and gold across the cow map. The Ancient guarantee applies to eligible legendary/set equipment only.
cow.note: This does not make every drop legendary. Gold, gems and materials keep their normal types and quality.

vault.name: Ancient Vault
vault.summary: Sacrifice an Ancient Puzzle Ring to enter the Ancient Vault. Hunt treasure and confront Greed with the same Ancient equipment guarantee as the special Cow Level.
steps: Obtain a Puzzle Ring while farming equipment. Choose an Ancient or Primal ring and confirm its quality in the tooltip.
In an Adventure Mode town, put only that ring into Kanai’s Cube and transmute. The ring is consumed; no extra crafting materials are required.
Enter the Vault portal with your party or alone. Defeat Greed, open the reward chest and collect your loot before the closing countdown ends.
facts: Ancient and Primal Puzzle Rings activate the Ancient Vault rule.
Eligible legendary/set equipment is forced to Ancient; Primal is not guaranteed.
The final chest has a minimum of 2 legendary items. The closing countdown lasts 60 seconds.
vault.reward: Gold, gems, crafting materials and equipment, with Ancient quality on eligible legendary/set drops.
vault.note: A regular Puzzle Ring opens the regular Vault. The Ancient rule does not upgrade gold, gems or materials.

visions.name: Visions of Enmity
visions.summary: A monster kill can open a fissure into a chain of dangerous floors. RuinWatch makes Visions available outside seasons too, with varied enemies and a final bounty-material chest.
steps: Farm normal monsters in the open world. Each eligible kill has a 1-in-300 portal roll; no key or Cube recipe is needed. This is a chance, not a guaranteed portal every 300 kills.
Enter the fissure when it appears. Kill enemies inside and take each new portal to progress through the 15 floors. Party members in the same game can enter too.
Finish the final floor and open the chest. Collect the rewards before the 30-second closing countdown ends.
facts: Available to non-seasonal characters; not restricted to seasonal play.
Inside a Vision, eligible kills roll a 15% chance to open the next floor. Floors become progressively tougher.
Rift floors, the Vault, Crimson Harvest and other excluded special arenas do not generate natural Vision entrances.
visions.reward: At Torment XVI, the final chest awards 30–60 bounty materials per act. Champion rewards include 3–4 Death’s Breaths and Guardian rewards 2–3 Greater Rift Keystones. Lower difficulties give smaller ranges.
visions.note: The final chest also rolls equipment. Floor variants can include champions, guardians, material packs or goblins; a particular variant is not guaranteed.

survival.name: The Crimson Harvest
survival.summary: A solo survival event with varied monsters, Blood Essence progression and three power choices at each milestone. Build a different combination of bonuses every run.
steps: At level 70, defeat Rift Guardians for a chance at Crimson Nightmare: 8% in Nephalem Rifts or 12% in Greater Rifts. Use the updated RuinWatch launcher to see its custom name.
While alive in an Adventure Mode town, place the item alone in Kanai’s Cube and transmute. One is consumed. Enter the blue Crimson Portal within 5 minutes; only the opener can enter, even in a party.
Kill monsters to fill the Blood Essence bar, then choose one of three named pillars. Survive the 12-minute main phase and defeat the King; you can finish or continue into Endless Harvest.
facts: Combat resources stay full. Life costs, cooldowns and Hardcore death rules still apply.
During power selection, combat pauses and you can move through monsters. Bonuses belong to the current run.
Death ends the run and still awards earned Platinum. Ordinary monster gold/item drops are disabled during the event.
survival.reward: At least 1 kill is required. Earn 1 Platinum per kill (up to 500), +250 for the King, +5 per endless minute and +1 per hunt kill (up to 10). Treasure Hunter can increase the result; the total cap is 1,000 Platinum per run.
survival.note: The reward is delivered once when the run ends, using the Platinum reward animation. You do not need to survive to the end to earn it; there are no gold or item rewards.
